features.available_timestamp: open_time+8h <= t; newest usable bar ends t
features.missing_data: bad row/gap excludes that non-BTC symbol at t; no interpolation
features.transformation: C(u)=close [u-8h,u]; r(u)=log(C(u)/C(u-8h)); last L spans t-(L-1)8h through t. Sample sd ddof=1, floor 1e-12; L=21,42,84,168

features.missing_data: bad event/coverage excludes that symbol; never zero-fill
features.source: manifest-frozen Binance USD-M archives/API gaps; funding.parquet
features.transformation: E_x is [t-xd,t). EWMs use E_84; persistence E_28. d_j is hours since immediate prior actual source event, derived before membership/window filters; predecessor may precede E_84

features.lag: all finite aligned pairs in 252 endpoints through t; minimum 189
features.missing_data: symbol failure is local; BTC failure flattens scheduled book
features.source: canonical BTCUSDT and symbol transaction closes
features.transformation: sample Cov/Var ddof=1; BTC Var>1e-16; ratio clipped [-0.5,3]; refit each rebalance

features.lag: current PIT set with executable open
features.missing_data: absent is ineligible; no survivor substitution

fault_policy: At scheduled t, malformed/duplicate/nonmonotone/gapped input removes only that non-BTC symbol; no imputation. Recompute N; flatten only on BTC failure, N<20, or construction failure
